goal: Expose spending transaction lookups over the unauthenticated REST interface.
Enables clients to check which transactions spend given outpoints without needing JSON-RPC.
reviewability: Ready for review with nothing known that would invalidate a review.
agreement: No open objections or blockers raised

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it brings REST parity with existing JSON-RPC functionality for spending lookups.
Useful for unauthenticated REST clients, but adds a new endpoint without critical urgency.
